name: cfd-pinn-boundary-condition-enforcement
description: 面向 PINN 求解不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 方程的边界条件施加策略：比较软边界条件（损失惩罚）与硬边界条件（架构约束）两种范式，涵盖 Dirichlet、Neumann、周期性边界条件的实现方式、精度对比和适用范围。硬边界通过网络架构保证边界满足，软边界通过损失项惩罚偏差。

evidence_papers.title: Solving Navier-Stokes Equations Using Data-free PINNs With Hard Boundary Conditions
Error Analysis of Tr-PINNs for 2D Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations with Non-Homogeneous BC
